svg.title: Police officer — Non-binary person
svg.desc: A fictional non-binary person working as police officer, wearing a work uniform and a service cap. Visible work cue: A two-way radio with antenna stands beside a separate plain shield badge. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Occupational headgear: a service cap.
